snippet.title: Avante! Atlantis | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Avante! Atlantis is a turn-based strategy game with a board game aesthetic. Capture territory, deploy units, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical battles. Every move counts as you fight for control of a resurged land rich in resources...and full of secrets.
